'''Leptospermeae''' is a tribe in the plant family [[Myrtaceae]]<ref>Wilson, P. G. (2011) Myrtaceae. In The Families and Genera of Vascular Plants. Volume X. Sapindales, Cucurbitales, Myrtaceae, edited by K. Kubitzki, X:212–71. Heidelberg: Springer-Verlag, 2011.</ref> from south-east Asia and Oceania with a main diversity center in [[Australia]].

==Genera==
*''[[Agonis]]'' (Australia)
*''[[Asteromyrtus]]'' (Australia)
*''[[Homalospermum]]'' (Australia)
*''[[Kunzea]]'' (Australia, [[New Zealand]])
*''[[Leptospermum]]''
*''[[Neofabricia]]'' (Australia)
*''[[Paragonis]]'' (Australia)
*''[[Pericalymma]]'' (Australia)
*''[[Taxandria (plant)|Taxandria]]'' (Australia)
